note: Both sets share the same core claims and the same errors, including an invented PVC material claim for cable/hose (the note only references sheet XE-001 for cable/hose carrier details) and a garbled, truncated quote ('MUM 1/4 IN/FT') for the slope claim that also duplicates the waste-pipe slope claim. Set A is slightly cleaner: it states the ceiling finish height once, whereas Set B states it twice under two names and adds an unsupported 'height above ground plane' attribute. Set A's only extra flaw is a duplicated bare '11 31 13.A7' identifier claim, which is less serious than B's invented elevation basis.
remarks: Both sets invent the quote 'TO BE PVC CABLE/HOSE' — the page only says 'REFER TO SHEET XE-001 FOR CABLE/HOSE CARRIER DETAILS', with no material given. Both also leave out several reference keynotes present on the page (DISHWASHER, DOMESTIC WATER PIPING, BOOSTER PUMP, HTP SUPERSTOR SOLAR WATER TANK, SOLAR PUMP STATION) and the FINISH FLOOR 2'-0 3/8" dimension. The bare 'system'/'component' identifier claims are vague and of little engineering use, and the text layer garbles 'MINIMUM' as 'MUM' in the slope quote.
